critical_code_review_comments: server.py decode_image_b64 helper: consider raising a typed DecodeError with a label field instead of accepting a Turkish error string arg — call sites currently duplicate the Turkish literal 'Geçersiz {logo,görsel} verisi' which is fine short-term but centralising the labels in a small enum/constants block would prevent copy-paste drift.

FRAME_STRIP_H/FRAME_BORDER constants now exist (good) but STRIP_TEXT is hardcoded 'PLENA SNAP · HR VISION 26' — if the event name is ever driven by settings, this should read from a config/env var similar to ADMIN_PIN.

LoginGate.jsx MAX_FRAME_ERRORS=150 loop guard is a great addition, but the constant lives in-file — extracting a small `constants.js` module alongside the animation constants (FADE_IN etc.) would make guardrails discoverable.

usePrint.js hook extracted from App.js — verify with a unit test that it properly memoises the print handler so ResultView doesn't re-render on unrelated App state changes (not verified this iteration since ResultView requires generation).

SlideshowView load useCallback + SLIDE_ANIM const: catch(err) logs a warning — good; but consider surfacing a user-facing toast if slideshow load fails so operators aren't left staring at a blank slide.
